subject: Surgical AI Leaders | SRS Miami Dinner, 23rd July
text:
Hi [NAME], hope all is well. Are you heading to SRS in Miami next week?

If so, I would like to extend an invitation to a private dinner Encord is
hosting during the conference, for surgical AI leaders to share their
experiences and challenges building AI in surgery and medtech.

The evening will take place at The Salon at the Premier Steakhouse,
Diplomat Prime
<[LINK]>
on Thursday 23rd July. The current attendee list includes Presidents and
CxOs from Intuitive, Nvidia, & J&J.

We'd love to have you join if you're in town! I will send over a formal
invite if you are.

If you're not attending this year, it would be great to reconnect. We've
been actively investing in our product to support medical AI teams and we
have a dedicated medical team responsible for building functionality for
these customers. As a result, we have signed many new customers this
quarter, including HOPPR
<[LINK]>
.

Would you be open to a virtual coffee next week?

subject: Ankur Kapoor recommended we chat | Encord
text:
Zdravo Sasha,

Ankur suggested I reach out. For context, his team evaluated Encord
successfully last year, and having reconnected recently, he recommended
meeting with you, [SENDER] and Puneet as the next step.

He flagged three challenges Healthineers is facing:

   1. Stricter FDA/PCCP requirements on annotation and data residency
   2. Growing use of video training data, requiring multimodal annotation
   3. A fast-growing number of post-PoC models across types and disease
   areas

Encord addresses all three through unified curation and annotation, plus
external expert medical services.

We'd like to scope your team's needs and build a picture of how we can save
engineering time and improve model performance across all the Healthineers
teams.

When would work to chat? I'm in the area 28th onwards, and would love to
meet in person.

subject: [COMPANY] | HITL at scale
text:

keeping it a "human space," would you be open to coffee to share
perspectives on the space?

Friday.
